claims.statement_id: Ia putra Millalobo, raja laut, dan Huenchula, seorang manusia; saudarinya adalah Sirena chilota dan Pincoya, yang juga istrinya.
claims.quote: He is the son of Millalobo (mythical king of the seas of Chiloé) and the human Huenchula; his sisters, are the Sirena chilota and the Pincoya (which also is his wife).

claims.statement: With his sisters he carries the dead from the sea to the Caleuche.
claims.statement_id: Bersama saudarinya ia membawa orang mati dari laut ke Caleuche.
claims.quote: With his sisters he carries the dead from the sea unto the Caleuche.

claims.statement: He sings a beautiful, strange song so the Pincoya begins her magical dance for the fertility of the sea.
claims.statement_id: Ia menyanyikan lagu indah dan aneh agar Pincoya memulai tarian gaibnya demi kesuburan laut.
claims.quote: he is responsible of singing a beautiful and strange song, so that the Pincoya start her magical dance, for fertility of the sea.

claims.statement: According to Chiloé Mitológico, the Pincoy has the body of a large seal in bright silver, with a handsome, manly human face and a thick golden mane.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Chiloé Mitológico, Pincoy bertubuh anjing laut besar berwarna perak mengilap, dengan wajah manusia yang tampan dan jantan serta surai emas yang lebat.
claims.quote: tiene cuerpo de foca de gran tamaño, color plateado brillante, con hermoso y varonil rostro humano, luciendo poblada melena dorada.

claims.statement: The Pincoy is the administrator of his father's domains, a strict inspector of the faithful fulfilment of his father's orders, and a careful watcher over all processes taking place in the seas.
claims.statement_id: Pincoy adalah pengelola wilayah kekuasaan ayahnya, pengawas yang ketat atas pelaksanaan perintah sang ayah, dan penjaga yang teliti atas jalannya semua proses di laut.
claims.quote: Es el administrador en los dominios de su padre; inspector severo del fiel cumplimiento de sus mandatos; vigilante acucioso del normal desenvolvimiento de todos los procesos que se desarrollan en los mares;

claims.statement: He always keeps watch over the activities of his sisters, the Pincoya and the Sirena.
claims.statement_id: Ia selalu mengawasi kegiatan saudari-saudarinya, Pincoya dan Sirena.
claims.quote: Permanece siempre atento a las actividades de sus hermanas, la Pincoya y la Sirena

claims.statement: Between the Pincoya and the Pincoy there is a rare union: the tale presents them as brother and sister and as husband and wife at the same time.
claims.statement_id: Antara Pincoya dan Pincoy ada ikatan yang aneh: kisah menyebut mereka sekaligus bersaudara dan suami istri.
claims.quote: Entre la Pincoya y el Pincoy, existe una rara unión. El relato los señala como hermanos y esposos al mismo tiempo.

claims.statement: The author suggests this may be explained as a duplication of the same legend, that of the marriage of Millalobo with Huenchula.
claims.statement_id: Penulis menafsirkan bahwa kenyataan ini mungkin dijelaskan sebagai penggandaan legenda yang sama, yaitu perkawinan Millalobo dengan Huenchula.
claims.quote: Podrían explicarse estos hechos, como una duplicación de la misma leyenda, del matrimonio del Millalobo con la Huenchula;

claims.statement: All versions agree that he is very handsome and attractive and likes music, especially the sound of a flute made of colihue; the author presumes his name comes from this fondness (Pinculhue = flute).
claims.statement_id: Semua versi sepakat bahwa ia sangat tampan dan memikat serta menyukai musik, terutama suara seruling dari colihue; penulis menduga namanya berasal dari kegemaran ini (Pinculhue = seruling).
claims.quote: Todas las versiones coinciden en decir que es muy hermoso, atrayente y que le agrada la música, sintiendo atracción muy especial, por la que produce la flauta hecha de colihue (a esta afición debe seguramente su nombre: de Pinculhue=flauta).

claims.statement: It is told that on the island of Alao, in the house of a girl admired for her beauty, a child with a seal's head was born who lived only a few hours, and paternity was blamed on the Pincoy.
claims.statement_id: Diceritakan bahwa di pulau Alao, di rumah seorang gadis yang dikagumi karena kecantikannya, lahir seorang anak berkepala anjing laut yang hidup hanya beberapa jam, dan ayahnya dituduhkan kepada Pincoy.
claims.quote: En la isla de Alao, se cuenta, que en la casa donde vivía una muchacha admirada como hermosa, nació un niño con cabeza de foca, que sólo vivió escasas horas y cuya paternidad se culpó al Pincoy;

claims.statement: Fishermen of the island of Llingua, famous for their seamanship, say they have seen the Pincoy while fishing, swimming at extraordinary speed and shining like a silver ray.
claims.statement_id: Nelayan pulau Llingua, yang terkenal karena kecakapan melautnya, mengaku pernah melihat Pincoy berenang dengan kecepatan luar biasa, berkilau seperti sinar perak, saat mereka menangkap ikan.
claims.quote: Pescadores de la isla Llingua, famosos por sus proezas marineras, cuentan haber visto al Pincoy, durante sus faenas de pesca, nadando a velocidad extraordinaria, brillando como un rayo plateado

claims.statement: Qailertetang is an Inuit goddess who cares for animals, fishers and hunters and controls the weather.
claims.statement_id: Qailertetang adalah dewi Inuit yang memelihara hewan, nelayan, dan pemburu serta mengendalikan cuaca.
claims.quote: Qailertetang is an Inuit goddess who cares for animals, fishers, and hunters and who controls the weather.

claims.statement: She lives with her companion Sedna at the bottom of the sea among seals, whales and other sea creatures.
claims.statement_id: Ia tinggal bersama rekannya, Sedna, di dasar laut bersama anjing laut, paus, dan makhluk laut lain.
claims.quote: She dwells with her companion Sedna at the bottom of the sea in the company of seals, whales, and other sea creatures.

claims.statement: Qailertetang is depicted as a "large woman of very heavy limbs".
claims.statement_id: Qailertetang digambarkan sebagai "perempuan besar dengan anggota tubuh yang sangat berat".
claims.quote: Qailertetang is depicted as a "large woman of very heavy limbs".

claims.statement: Before hunts, shamans serve her and Sedna in rituals to ensure success.
claims.statement_id: Sebelum perburuan, para dukun melayaninya bersama Sedna dalam ritual demi keberhasilan berburu.
claims.quote: Before hunts, she, along with Sedna, are served by shamans on behalf of the rest of the tribe in rituals designed to ensure success in said hunts

claims.statement: The word also names two ritual figures in Quviasukvik, the most important Inuit new year holiday.
claims.statement_id: Kata ini juga menyebut dua sosok ritual dalam Quviasukvik, perayaan tahun baru Inuit yang paling penting.
claims.quote: The word also used to refer to two ritual figures in the Inuit new year holiday, Quviasukvik, the most important Inuit holiday.

claims.statement: Inuit scholars Laugrand and Oosten call them representatives of Sedna.
claims.statement_id: Peneliti Inuit Laugrand dan Oosten menyebut kedua sosok itu wakil Sedna.
claims.quote: Inuit scholars Laugrand and Oosten call them the representatives of Sedna.

claims.statement: Out of a hut stalk two gigantic figures wearing heavy boots, their legs swelled to a wonderful thickness with several pairs of breeches.
claims.statement_id: Dari sebuah pondok keluar dua sosok raksasa yang memakai sepatu bot berat, dengan kaki membengkak tebal oleh beberapa lapis celana.
claims.quote: out of which stalk two gigantic figures. They wear heavy boots; their legs are swelled out to a wonderful thickness with several pairs of breeches;

claims.statement: The qailertetang approach the assembly silently with long strides, while the people, screaming, press back from them.
claims.statement_id: Para qailertetang mendekati kerumunan dengan diam dan langkah panjang, sementara orang-orang berteriak dan mundur dari mereka.
claims.quote: Silently, with long strides, the qailertetang (Fig. 535) approach the assembly, who, screaming, press back from them.

claims.statement: After this duty the qailertetang stride down to the shore and invoke the good north wind, which brings fair weather, while warning off the unfavorable south wind.
claims.statement_id: Setelah tugas itu, para qailertetang melangkah ke pantai dan memanggil angin utara yang baik, pembawa cuaca cerah, sambil mengusir angin selatan yang tidak menguntungkan.
claims.quote: Having performed this duty, the qailertetang stride down to the shore and invoke the good north wind, which brings fair weather, while they warn off the unfavorable south wind.

claims.statement: As soon as the incantation is over, all the men attack the qailertetang with great noise, acting as if they had weapons and would kill both spirits.
claims.statement_id: Begitu mantra selesai, semua pria menyerang para qailertetang dengan gaduh, berlagak membawa senjata dan hendak membunuh kedua "roh" itu.
claims.quote: As soon as the incantation is over, all the men attack the qailertetang with great noise. They act as if they had weapons in their hands and would kill both spirits.

claims.statement: Each man fills his sealskin with water, passes them a cup, and asks about the future, the fortunes of the hunt and the events of life; the qailertetang answer in murmurs that the questioner must interpret himself.
claims.statement_id: Tiap pria mengisi kantong kulit anjing lautnya dengan air, menyodorkan cangkir kepada mereka, dan bertanya tentang masa depan, nasib perburuan, dan peristiwa hidup; para qailertetang menjawab dengan gumaman yang harus ditafsirkan sendiri oleh penanya.
claims.quote: Each man fills his sealskin with water, passes a cup to them, and inquires about the future, about the fortunes of the hunt and the events of life. The qailertetang answer in murmurs which the questioner must interpret for himself.

claims.statement: The Akudnirmiut celebrate the feast without the qailertetang; other masks called mirqussang, representing a man and his wife, take their place.
claims.statement_id: Orang Akudnirmiut merayakan pesta itu tanpa qailertetang; topeng lain yang disebut mirqussang, yang mewakili seorang pria dan istrinya, menggantikannya.
claims.quote: The Akudnirmiut celebrate the feast in the following way: The qailertetang do not act a part there, but other masks take their place. They are called mirqussang and represent a man and his wife.

claims.statement: The muki is a goblin-like creature of Central Andean mythology in Bolivia, Peru, Ecuador and Colombia.
claims.statement_id: Muki adalah makhluk mirip goblin dalam mitologi Andes Tengah di Bolivia, Peru, Ekuador, dan Kolombia.
claims.quote: is a goblin-like creature in the mythology of the Central Andes in Bolivia, Peru, Ecuador and Colombia.

claims.statement: He is a miner whose existence is confined underground: the muki lives inside the mines.
claims.statement_id: Ia dikenal sebagai penambang yang hanya hidup di ruang bawah tanah, yaitu di dalam tambang.
claims.quote: He is known to be a miner and his existence is constrained to underground spaces: The muki lives inside the mines.

claims.statement: The muki is considered a dwarf, no taller than 2 feet.
claims.statement_id: Muki dianggap kurcaci karena tingginya tidak lebih dari 2 kaki.
claims.quote: The muki is considered to be a dwarf due to its height, since it is no taller than 2 feet (0.61 meters).

claims.statement: In some mining traditions he has two horns to break rocks and point to mineral veins.
claims.statement_id: Dalam beberapa tradisi tambang, ia bertanduk dua untuk memecah batu dan menunjuk urat mineral.
claims.quote: In some mining traditions, he has two horns that are used to break the rocks and point at the mineral veins.

claims.statement: Sometimes he turns into an animal or a blond white man to deceive the miners.
claims.statement_id: Kadang ia berubah menjadi hewan atau lelaki kulit putih berambut pirang untuk menipu para penambang.
claims.quote: Sometimes he shape-shifts into an animal or a blonde white man to appear to the miners and deceive them.

claims.statement: Elders advise fighting the muki with one's belt without giving in to fear.
claims.statement_id: Para tetua menasihati agar melawan muki dengan ikat pinggang tanpa takut.
claims.quote: Elders advise that, when dealing with the muki, one should use his/her belt to battle him without succumbing to fear.

claims.statement: Legends of the Muki are shared in isolated mining camps from Colombia in the north to Bolivia in the south, and in the Peruvian Andes between; its name differs by region, for example chinchiliku in the Moquegua region and jusshi in the Cajamarca region.
claims.statement_id: Legenda Muki dituturkan di kamp-kamp tambang terpencil dari Kolombia di utara hingga Bolivia di selatan dan di Andes Peru di antaranya; namanya berbeda antardaerah, misalnya chinchiliku di wilayah Moquegua dan jusshi di wilayah Cajamarca.
claims.quote: Legends of the Muki have been consistently shared over the years in isolated mining camps as far north as Colombia, as far south as Bolivia, and in the Peruvian Andes in between. However, its name differs from region to region – people in the Moquegua region in the south of Peru speak of a chinchiliku, and those in the northern Cajamarca region call it the jusshi.

claims.statement: According to this article, the word muki comes from the Quechua word murik, meaning "to smother" or "to strangle", a reference to the often lethal dust and silica that would fill miners' lungs.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ini, kata muki berasal dari kata Quechua murik yang berarti "mencekik" atau "menyesakkan", merujuk pada debu dan silika yang sering mematikan dan memenuhi paru-paru penambang.
claims.quote: The word muki comes from the Quechua word murik, which means “to smother” or “to strangle,” a reference to the often lethal dust and silica that would fill miners’ lungs.

claims.statement: One common theme in Muki lore is its tendency to make deals with miners; it is said to trade valuable mining knowledge or help for luxuries such as alcohol or coca.
claims.statement_id: Satu tema umum dalam cerita Muki adalah kecenderungannya membuat kesepakatan dengan penambang; ia konon menukar pengetahuan atau bantuan penambangan yang berharga dengan barang mewah seperti alkohol atau koka.
claims.quote: One common theme in Muki lore is the tendency for the creature to make deals with miners. The Muki is said to trade valuable mining knowledge or help in exchange for luxuries such as alcohol or coca.

claims.statement: However, the Muki plays the part of a trickster or demon, and these deals can backfire badly for miners who are greedy and indiscreet about their luck.
claims.statement_id: Namun Muki berperan sebagai penipu atau iblis, dan kesepakatan itu bisa berbalik buruk bagi penambang yang serakah dan ceroboh membicarakan keberuntungannya.
claims.quote: However, the Muki plays the part of a trickster or demon, and these deals can backfire badly for miners who are greedy and indiscreet about their luck.

claims.statement: The article calls the most plausible explanation for the rise and spread of Muki legends that the creature personifies the dangers and risks miners accept in their line of work.
claims.statement_id: Artikel ini menyebut penjelasan paling masuk akal bagi munculnya legenda Muki adalah bahwa makhluk itu mempersonifikasikan bahaya dan risiko yang diterima penambang dalam pekerjaan mereka.
claims.quote: The most plausible – and unfortunate – explanation for the rise and spread of Muki legends involve the creature as a personification of the dangers and risks miners accept in their line of work.

claims.statement: Some stories paint the creature in a more positive light, as a mysterious but helpful figure who can lead miners to productive ore deposits or warn them of dangers underground.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian cerita menggambarkannya secara lebih positif, sebagai tokoh misterius tetapi suka menolong yang dapat menuntun penambang ke endapan bijih yang produktif atau memperingatkan mereka akan bahaya di bawah tanah.
claims.quote: Some stories paint the creature in a more positive light, as a mysterious but helpful figure who can lead miners to productive ore deposits or warn them of dangers underground.

claims.statement: Some legends paint him as a predatory goblin searching for unsuspecting children or isolated miners to attack, but in general the Muki has become a catch-all for the mysterious goings-on underground.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian legenda menggambarkannya sebagai goblin pemangsa yang mencari anak-anak atau penambang terpencil untuk diserang, tetapi pada umumnya keberadaan Muki menjadi penjelasan serba guna untuk kejadian misterius di bawah tanah.
claims.quote: while some legends paint him as something of a predatory goblin searching for unsuspecting children or isolated miners to attack, in general the existence of the Muki has become a sort of catch-all for the mysterious goings-on underground.

claims.statement: According to oral tradition, the Muki is no more than two feet tall yet disproportionately muscular, with a deep voice; his skin is described as ghostly pale, with long blond hair and dazzling eyes that reflect the light like the metals in the mines.
claims.statement_id: Menurut tradisi lisan, Muki tidak lebih tinggi dari dua kaki namun berotot tidak proporsional dan bersuara dalam; kulitnya digambarkan pucat seperti hantu, dengan rambut pirang panjang dan mata berkilau yang memantulkan cahaya seperti logam di tambang.
claims.quote: According to oral tradition, the Muki is no more than two feet in height, yet is disproportionately muscular, with a deep voice. His skin is described as ghostly pale, with long blond hair framing dazzling eyes that reflect the light, like the metals in the mines he inhabits.

claims.statement: In Canadian folklore, Mussie is a creature said to live in Muskrat Lake, Ontario.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Kanada, Mussie adalah makhluk yang konon hidup di Muskrat Lake, Ontario.
claims.quote: In Canadian folklore, Mussie is a creature said to live in Muskrat Lake in the Canadian province of Ontario.

claims.statement: It is variously described, e.g. as a walrus or a three-eyed Loch Ness Monster-like creature.
claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan beragam, misalnya seperti walrus atau makhluk bermata tiga mirip Loch Ness Monster.
claims.quote: It is variously described, for example, as a walrus or as a three-eyed Loch Ness Monster-like creature.

claims.statement: The legend likely began around 1916, though it is claimed Samuel de Champlain wrote of it in the early seventeenth century.
claims.statement_id: Legenda Mussie kemungkinan dimulai sekitar 1916, meski ada klaim bahwa Samuel de Champlain menulis tentangnya pada awal abad ke-17.
claims.quote: The legend of Mussie likely began around 1916, though legend claims that Canadian pioneer Samuel de Champlain wrote about it in the early seventeenth century.

claims.statement: Its name was originally Hapyxelor (or Hapaxelor), later changed to Mussie, short for The Monster of Muskrat Lake.
claims.statement_id: Nama awalnya Hapyxelor (juga Hapaxelor), kemudian diganti Mussie, singkatan dari The Monster of Muskrat Lake.
claims.quote: The creature's name was originally cited as Hapyxelor, alternately spelled Hapaxelor, but changed simply to Mussie, short for The Monster of Muskrat Lake, sometime later.

claims.statement: Mussie has become a local mascot, appearing on signs welcoming visitors to Cobden.
claims.statement_id: Mussie menjadi maskot budaya daerah itu dan muncul di papan selamat datang Cobden.
claims.quote: Mussie has become a cultural mascot of the area, appearing on signs welcoming visitors to Cobden and in front of the Home Hardware store in the village.

claims.statement: Mussie is said to live in Muskrat Lake, a large, very deep lake 75 miles northwest of Ottawa, near the village of Cobden.
claims.statement_id: Mussie konon hidup di Muskrat Lake, danau besar yang sangat dalam sekitar 75 mil di barat laut Ottawa, dekat desa Cobden.
claims.quote: Mussie is said to live in Muskrat Lake, a large, very deep lake 75 miles northwest of Ottawa, near the village of Cobden.

claims.statement: The creature is said to have three eyes, sharp teeth and to tower over the water whenever it raises its head; or perhaps it looks like a sturgeon.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk itu konon bermata tiga, bergigi tajam, dan menjulang di atas air setiap kali mengangkat kepala; atau mungkin rupanya seperti ikan sturgeon.
claims.quote: The creature is said to have three eyes, sharp teeth and towers over the water whenever it raises its head. Or maybe it looks like a sturgeon.

claims.statement: Some say Mussie started with Samuel de Champlain, although the article states that Champlain never wrote about the monster.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian orang menyebut Mussie bermula dari Samuel de Champlain, padahal menurut artikel ini Champlain tidak pernah menulis tentang monster itu.
claims.quote: Others will tell you, no, Mussie started with Samuel de Champlain, even though Champlain never wrote about the monster.

claims.statement: For many years the village of Cobden used the Loch Ness-style depiction, a three-eyed monster, on its Welcome to Cobden sign.
claims.statement_id: Selama bertahun-tahun desa Cobden memakai gambaran ala Loch Ness, yaitu monster bermata tiga pada papan selamat datang desa itu.
claims.quote: For many years the village of Cobden went with the Loch-Ness-monster depiction, showing a monster with three eyes on its Welcome to Cobden sign.

claims.statement: In the local tale reported by the article, Mussie was some sort of pre-historic animal trapped in the lake when the last glaciers retreated 10,000 years ago.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah setempat yang dilaporkan artikel ini, Mussie adalah semacam hewan prasejarah yang terperangkap di danau ketika gletser terakhir surut 10.000 tahun lalu.
claims.quote: Mussie was some sort of pre-historic animal, trapped in the lake when the last glaciers retreated 10,000 years ago.

claims.statement: According to the article's author, any good lake monster story needs a witness, and for the Monster of Muskrat Lake that witness was Donnie Humphries.
claims.statement_id: Menurut penulis artikel, kisah monster danau yang baik butuh saksi, dan bagi Monster of Muskrat Lake saksinya adalah Donnie Humphries.
claims.quote: any good lake monster story needs a witness and for the Monster of Muskrat Lake, that witness was Donnie Humphries.

claims.statement: Muskrat Lake in the Ottawa Valley has a long and storied history as the home of a lake monster affectionately called Mussie, or more formally Hapyxelor.
claims.statement_id: Muskrat Lake di Ottawa Valley memiliki sejarah panjang sebagai tempat tinggal monster danau yang disebut dengan sayang Mussie, atau secara lebih resmi Hapyxelor.
claims.quote: Muskrat Lake in the Ottawa Valley has a long and storied history of being the home to a lake monster affectionately called Mussie, or more formally named Hapyxelor.

claims.statement: The North Shore Monster, sometimes called "Old Briney," reportedly inhabits the Great Salt Lake in Utah.
claims.statement_id: North Shore Monster, kadang disebut "Old Briney", konon menghuni Great Salt Lake di Utah.
claims.quote: The North Shore Monster, sometimes referred to as "Old Briney," reportedly inhabits the Great Salt Lake in Utah.

claims.statement: Descriptions vary, but it is most often described with a crocodile-like body and a horse's head.
claims.statement_id: Gambarannya beragam, tetapi paling sering bertubuh mirip buaya dan berkepala kuda.
claims.quote: Descriptions of the monster vary, but it is most commonly described as having a crocodile-like body and the head of a horse.

claims.statement: The best-known sighting was on July 8, 1877, when J.H. McNeil and saltworks workers near Monument Point claimed to meet a large creature.
claims.statement_id: Penampakan paling terkenal terjadi pada 8 Juli 1877, ketika J.H. McNeil dan pekerja tambang garam dekat Monument Point mengaku bertemu makhluk besar.
claims.quote: The most well-known sighting occurred on July 8, 1877, when J.H. McNeil and other workers at the Barnes and Co. saltworks near Monument Point on the lake's northern shore claimed to have encountered a large creature

claims.statement: McNeil estimated it at about 75 feet long.
claims.statement_id: McNeil memperkirakan panjang makhluk itu sekitar 75 kaki.
claims.quote: McNeil estimated the creature to be about 75 feet long.

claims.statement: However, the Deseret News suggested taking the report "with a few grains of salt."
claims.statement_id: Namun Deseret News menyarankan agar laporan itu tidak dipercaya begitu saja.
claims.quote: However, the Deseret News suggested that the report should be taken "with a few grains of salt."

claims.statement: J.H. McNeil of Kelton, Box Elder County, and several other men were working for the Barnes and Company saltworks on the northern shore near Monument Point and the Central Pacific railroad line in early July 1877 when they heard a frightful bellow.
claims.statement_id: J.H. McNeil dari Kelton, Box Elder County, dan beberapa pria lain bekerja untuk tambang garam Barnes and Company di tepi utara dekat Monument Point dan jalur kereta Central Pacific pada awal Juli 1877 ketika mereka mendengar raungan yang menakutkan.
claims.quote: J.H. McNeil of Kelton, Box Elder County, and several other men were working for the Barnes and Company saltworks on the northern shore near Monument Point and the Central Pacific railroad line in early July of 1877 when they heard a frightful bellow.

claims.statement: As McNeil tells it, they saw an awful creature with a crocodile-like body and a horse's head; when it saw the men it charged toward them and they fled to the mountains.
claims.statement_id: Menurut penuturan McNeil, mereka melihat makhluk mengerikan bertubuh mirip buaya dan berkepala kuda; ketika makhluk itu melihat para pria, ia menyerbu ke arah mereka dan mereka lari ke pegunungan.
claims.quote: As McNeil tells it, they looked up and saw an awful creature with a crocodile-like body and the head of a horse. As it saw the men, it charged toward them and they fled to the mountains.

claims.statement: McNeil signed an affidavit of the account, and a story on the sighting was published in the Corinne Record and later in the Deseret News.
claims.statement_id: McNeil menandatangani afidavit atas kisah itu, dan berita tentang penampakan tersebut dimuat di Corinne Record lalu di Deseret News.
claims.quote: McNeil signed an affidavit of the account, and a story on the sighting was published in the Corinne Record and later the Deseret News.

claims.statement: According to another account, huge overturned boulders marked the trail of the marauding beast.
claims.statement_id: Menurut catatan lain, batu-batu besar yang terbalik menandai jejak makhluk yang mengamuk itu.
claims.quote: According to another account, huge overturned boulders marked the trail of the marauding beast.

claims.statement: Some believe the monster may have been a buffalo.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian orang percaya bahwa monster itu mungkin seekor kerbau (bison).
claims.quote: Some believe the monster may have been a buffalo.

claims.statement: In Canadian folklore, Seelkee (from the Halqemeylem language) is a lake monster said to have lived in the swamps of present-day Chilliwack, British Columbia.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Kanada, Seelkee (dari bahasa Halqemeylem) adalah monster danau yang konon hidup di rawa-rawa wilayah yang kini menjadi Chilliwack, British Columbia.
claims.quote: In Canadian folklore, Seelkee (transcribed in English from Halqemeylem, the local indigenous language) is a lake monster reported to have lived in the swamps of what is now Chilliwack, in British Columbia, Canada.

claims.statement: Seelkee has reportedly been seen by the Stó:lō people for hundreds of years.
claims.statement_id: Seelkee konon telah dilihat orang Stó:lō selama ratusan tahun.
claims.quote: Seelkee has been allegedly seen by the Stó:lō, First Nations, people for hundreds of years.

claims.statement: Most commonly it is a 10- to 15-foot sea-serpent-like beast with a horse's head.
claims.statement_id: Gambaran paling umum adalah makhluk mirip ular laut sepanjang 10 hingga 15 kaki berkepala kuda.
claims.quote: The most common description of Seelkee is a 10- to 15-foot-long (3.0 to 4.6 m) sea serpent-like beast with the head of a horse.

claims.statement: It is often portrayed as a two-headed snake, mostly black with red circular designs.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga sering digambarkan seperti ular berkepala dua, berwarna hitam dengan pola lingkaran merah.
claims.quote: Descriptions often portray the creature as snake-like with two heads. Furthermore, the coloration has been described as mostly black with red circular designs.

claims.statement: Some Stó:lō longhouses had large house posts with red-painted Seelkee designs.
claims.statement_id: Beberapa rumah panjang di desa Stó:lō memiliki tiang besar bermotif Seelkee dengan cat merah.
claims.quote: Some of the longhouses in the local Stó:lō villages were defined by large house posts with Seelkee designs accented with red paint.

claims.statement: Living in winding channels and marshlands, s’í:lhqey are normally described as serpents with two heads.
claims.statement_id: Hidup di saluran berkelok dan rawa, s’í:lhqey biasanya digambarkan sebagai ular berkepala dua.
claims.quote: Living in winding channels and marshlands, s’í:lhqey are normally described as serpents with two heads.

claims.statement: S’í:lhqey have the power to cause a person’s body to twist and become sick until death if a person runs upon seeing the creature.
claims.statement_id: S’í:lhqey memiliki kuasa membuat tubuh seseorang terpelintir dan sakit sampai mati jika orang itu lari ketika melihat makhluk tersebut.
claims.quote: have the power to cause a person’s body to twist and become sick until death if a person runs upon seeing the creature.

claims.statement: In a recollection quoted by the museum, it was like a big snake, only with a horse's head, long and smooth, with a long mouth and long ears like a horse's.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kesaksian yang dikutip museum, makhluk itu seperti ular besar, hanya kepalanya seperti kepala kuda, panjang dan halus, dengan mulut panjang dan telinga panjang seperti kuda.
claims.quote: It was like a big snake only the head like a horse’s head - long and smooth - a long mouth - long ears like a horse’s

claims.statement: According to a recollection quoted by the museum, the creature could fly from lake to lake.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kesaksian yang dikutip museum, makhluk itu bisa terbang dari danau ke danau.
claims.quote: how that thing could fly I don’t know; but the Indian said that thing could fly from lake to lake.

claims.statement: In one quoted account, a man swam out to the serpent, grabbed it and threw grass into its mouth, which killed it.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu kisah yang dikutip, seorang pria berenang ke arah ular itu, menangkapnya, dan memasukkan rumput ke mulutnya sehingga ia mati.
claims.quote: To kill it, the man swam out to it and grabbed it and threw grass into its mouth, which killed it.

claims.statement: In the same account, the man painted a picture of the serpent across the front of his big house, over the door, to protect that house.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah yang sama, pria itu melukis gambar ular di depan rumah besarnya, di atas pintu, untuk melindungi rumah tersebut.
claims.quote: painted a picture of the serpent across the front of his big house, over the door. ... he pictured the shape of that serpent over the door to protect that house.

claims.statement: The captions on the museum page are taken from Oliver N. Wells, Myths and Legends: STAW-loh INDIANS of South Western British Columbia (Vancouver, 1970).
claims.statement_id: Keterangan gambar pada halaman museum itu diambil dari Oliver N. Wells, Myths and Legends: STAW-loh INDIANS of South Western British Columbia (Vancouver, 1970).
claims.quote: Captions provided from: Wells, Oliver N. Myths and Legends: STAW-loh INDIANS of South Western British Columbia. Vancouver, BC: Frank T. Coan Ltd, 1970.

claims.statement: In the recollection quoted by the museum about the two-headed flying creature, the speaker says that this is what they called a SEEL-kee.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kesaksian yang dikutip museum tentang makhluk berkepala dua yang bisa terbang itu, penuturnya berkata bahwa itulah yang disebut SEEL-kee.
claims.quote: That’s a *SEEL-kee - that’s what they called it.

claims.statement: In Northern Paiute oral history, the Si-Te-Cah were a legendary tribe the Paiutes fought and drove out, with a final battle at Lovelock Cave, Nevada.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sejarah lisan Paiute Utara, Si-Te-Cah adalah suku legendaris yang mereka perangi dan usir, dengan pertempuran terakhir di Lovelock Cave, Nevada.
claims.quote: were a legendary tribe with whom the Northern Paiutes fought a war and eventually wiped out or drove away from the area, with the final battle having taken place at what is now known as Lovelock Cave near Lovelock, Nevada, United States.

claims.statement: They were said to be red-haired, sometimes cannibals, and in later versions giants.
claims.statement_id: Mereka konon berambut merah, kadang disebut kanibal, dan dalam versi belakangan digambarkan sebagai raksasa.
claims.quote: They were said to have red hair, and are sometimes described as having been cannibals.  In some later versions of the legend they were giants.

claims.statement: In Northern Paiute, "Si-Te-Cah" means "tule-eaters".
claims.statement_id: Dalam bahasa Paiute Utara, "Si-Te-Cah" berarti "pemakan tule".
claims.quote: "Si-Te-Cah" means "tule-eaters"  in the Northern Paiute language.

claims.statement: To escape the Paiutes, they reportedly lived on tule rafts on Lake Humboldt.
claims.statement_id: Untuk menghindari gangguan orang Paiute, mereka konon tinggal di rakit tule di Danau Humboldt.
claims.quote: In order to escape harassment from the Paiutes, the Si-Te-Cahs were said to have lived on rafts made of tule on Lake Humboldt.

claims.statement: Archaeologists Loud and Harrington doubted whether these were real traditions or an attempt by the Northern Paiute to explain earlier archaeological remains.
claims.statement_id: Arkeolog Loud dan Harrington meragukan apakah kisah ini tradisi sejarah nyata atau upaya Paiute Utara menjelaskan sisa arkeologi dari masa sebelum mereka.
claims.quote: They expressed doubts over whether these were real historical traditions or whether, "they should be regarded as an attempt by the Northern Paiute to explain the archaeological remains of a cultural period preceding their own".

claims.statement: The author records one of her people's traditions: a small tribe of "barbarians" who lived along the Humboldt River many hundred years ago and waylaid her people, killing and eating them.
claims.statement_id: Penulis menyebut salah satu tradisi bangsanya: suku kecil "barbar" yang dahulu tinggal di sepanjang Sungai Humboldt, ratusan tahun lalu, yang menghadang orang-orangnya lalu membunuh dan memakan mereka.
claims.quote: Among the traditions of our people is one of a small tribe of barbarians who used to live along the Humboldt River. It was many hundred years ago. They used to waylay my people and kill and eat them.

claims.statement: In the tradition, they then made tule (bulrush) boats and went into Humboldt Lake, but could not live there very long without fire.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi itu, mereka kemudian membuat perahu dari tule (bulrush) dan masuk ke Danau Humboldt, tetapi tidak bisa hidup lama di sana tanpa api.
claims.quote: Then they went to work and made tuly or bulrush boats, and went into Humboldt Lake. They could not live there very long without fire.

claims.statement: The author's people gathered wood and began to fill up the mouth of the cave; those inside pulled the wood inside until the cave was full, and then the author's people set it on fire.
claims.statement_id: Orang-orang penulis mengumpulkan kayu dan menyumbat mulut gua; yang di dalam menarik kayu itu masuk sampai gua penuh, lalu kayu itu dibakar.
claims.quote: gathered wood, and began to fill up the mouth of the cave. Then the poor fools began to pull the wood inside till the cave was full. At last my people set it on fire

claims.statement: According to the author's people, the tribe they exterminated had reddish hair; the author says she has some of their hair, handed down from father to son.
claims.statement_id: Menurut orang-orang penulis, suku yang mereka musnahkan itu berambut kemerahan; penulis menyebut menyimpan sebagian rambut mereka yang diwariskan dari ayah ke anak.
claims.quote: My people say that the tribe we exterminated had reddish hair. I have some of their hair, which has been handed down from father to son.

claims.statement: The Northern Paiute have a legend that the cave was once the home of a tribe to whom they apply the name Sai-i.
claims.statement_id: Orang Paiute Utara punya legenda bahwa gua itu dahulu rumah suatu suku yang mereka beri nama Sai-i.
claims.quote: relates that the cave was once the home of a tribe to whom the Northern Paiute apply the name Sai-i

claims.statement: According to the legend, they made their living from the lake and were enemies of the Northern Paiute, especially unpopular for capturing Northern Paiute women who came to the northwest side of Humboldt lake to gather tule rushes for mats.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda itu, mereka hidup dari danau dan menjadi musuh Paiute Utara, terutama karena menangkap perempuan Paiute Utara yang datang ke sisi barat laut Danau Humboldt untuk mengumpulkan rumput tule bagi tikar.
claims.quote: These people made their living from the lake, and were enemies of the Northern Paiute, among whom they made themselves especially unpopular by capturing the Northern Paiute women when the latter visited the northwest side of Humboldt lake to gather tule rushes for mats.

claims.statement: The authors judge that, unlike beliefs in northwestern California about an ancient race of supernatural beings, the "former people" of Nevada seem to have been ordinary human beings living an entirely rational human life.
claims.statement_id: Para penulis menilai bahwa, berbeda dari kepercayaan di California barat laut tentang ras purba supernatural, "orang-orang dahulu" Nevada tampak sebagai manusia biasa yang menjalani hidup rasional.
claims.quote: there seems to be the difference that the former people of Nevada were ordinary human beings living an entirely rational human life.

claims.statement: The authors say the fire-arrow foreshafts found tend to confirm the Northern Paiute legend of the assault on the cave.
claims.statement_id: Para penulis menyebut bahwa ujung panah api yang ditemukan cenderung menguatkan legenda Paiute Utara tentang serangan ke gua.
claims.quote: Tending to confirm the Northern Paiute legend of the assault on the cave are the fire-arrow foreshafts shown in plate 46c, d.

claims.statement: But the authors also say the specimens of the Later Period are much more like Northern Paiute products than like those of the Pit River people, who the legend states were the cave dwellers, which tends to refute the legend.
claims.statement_id: Namun para penulis juga menyebut bahwa benda-benda Periode Akhir lebih mirip hasil karya Paiute Utara daripada karya orang Pit River, yang menurut legenda adalah penghuni gua, sehingga cenderung membantah legenda itu.
claims.quote: but tending to refute it is the fact that the specimens of the Later Period are much more like Northern Paiute products than like those of the Pit River people who, the legend states, were the cave dwellers.

claims.statement: La Tulevieja (also Tulivieja) is a legendary figure of Costa Rican and Panamanian folklore, a ghost wearing a distinctive hat called a tule.
claims.statement_id: La Tulevieja (juga Tulivieja) adalah tokoh legenda cerita rakyat Kosta Rika dan Panama, hantu bertopi khas yang disebut tule.
claims.quote: La Tulevieja (also spelled Tulivieja) is a legendary figure from Costa Rican and Panamanian folklore. She is a ghost who wears a distinctive hat called a tule.

claims.statement: She is also often described as a woman-bird hybrid, like a harpy.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga sering digambarkan sebagai campuran perempuan dan burung, mirip harpy.
claims.quote: She is also commonly described as a hybrid of woman and bird (similar to a harpy)

claims.statement: Her hallmark is eagle or hawk legs and claws that leave reversed footprints so she cannot be followed.
claims.statement_id: Ciri utamanya adalah kaki dan cakar elang yang meninggalkan jejak terbalik sehingga ia tidak bisa diikuti.
claims.quote: her most characteristic features are her legs and claws of an eagle or hawk instead of human legs, which leave reversed footprints so that she cannot be followed.

claims.statement: She reportedly eats charcoal and ashes, so her tracks appear near recently doused campfires.
claims.statement_id: Ia konon memakan arang dan abu, sehingga jejaknya sering ditemukan di sekitar api unggun yang baru padam.
claims.quote: She is said to feed on charcoal and ashes, which is why it is common to find her tracks around recently extinguished campfires.

claims.statement: The only escape is to recite "Alabado sea el Santísimo", which makes her fly off toward the sun.
claims.statement_id: Satu-satunya cara menyelamatkan diri adalah mendaraskan doa "Alabado sea el Santísimo", yang membuatnya terbang dan menghilang ke arah matahari.
claims.quote: The only way to save oneself once encountering her is to recite the prayer "Alabado sea el Santísimo" ("Praised be the Most Holy Sacrament"), which causes her to take flight and disappear toward the sun.

claims.statement: In the legend, a beautiful girl had a secret relationship with a man from her town and became pregnant, drowned the child in a river and was punished by God by being turned into a hideous creature (in some versions she also drowns herself).
claims.statement_id: Dalam legenda, seorang gadis cantik menjalin hubungan rahasia dengan seorang pria di kotanya hingga hamil, menenggelamkan anaknya di sungai, lalu dihukum Tuhan menjadi makhluk mengerikan (dalam beberapa versi ia juga menenggelamkan diri).
claims.quote: In the legend, a beautiful girl had a secret relationship with a man from her town, resulting in pregnancy. She drowned the child in a river and was punished by God by being transformed into a hideous creature (in some versions she drowns herself as well).

claims.statement: In this version published by the Costa Rican education ministry, she was a little old woman who lived near the Virilla river in a dilapidated shack and wore a big tule hat to shield herself from the sun.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi yang disusun kementerian pendidikan Kosta Rika ini, ia adalah seorang nenek yang tinggal dekat Sungai Virilla di gubuk reyot dan memakai topi besar dari tule untuk melindungi diri dari matahari.
claims.quote: Esta era una viejita que vivía cerca del río Virilla en una casucha destartalada por el tiempo, usaba para taparse del sol un gran sombrero de

claims.statement: In this version she is described with bare breasts, hawk legs (gavilán), bat wings, a witch's face and a load of firewood.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi ini ia dilukiskan dengan dada telanjang, kaki elang pemangsa (gavilán), sayap kelelawar, wajah penyihir, dan membawa kayu bakar.
claims.quote: pechos al desnudo, patas de gavilán, alas de murciélago, rostro de bruja y carga de leña.

claims.statement: It is said that she takes flight and falls upon a person in mortal sin, tearing the person to pieces.
claims.statement_id: Dikatakan ia terbang lalu jatuh menimpa orang yang sedang berdosa berat dan mencabik-cabiknya.
claims.quote: Se dice que alza vuelo y cae sobre la persona despedazándola cuando esta se encuentra en pecado mortal.

claims.statement: Mocking children gave her the nickname Tulevieja and took pleasure in tormenting her.
claims.statement_id: Anak-anak yang suka mengejek memberinya julukan Tulevieja dan senang mengganggunya.
claims.quote: La chiquillería burlona le puso el apodo de Tulevieja, y se complacía en molestarla.

claims.statement: One day the wind blew her hat into the turbulent waters of the then swollen Tiribi river, carrying it away; she went after it and the head of water of the great flood drowned her.
claims.statement_id: Suatu hari angin menerbangkan topinya jatuh ke arus deras Sungai Tiribi yang sedang banjir; ia mengejarnya dan dihanyutkan banjir besar hingga tenggelam.
claims.quote: Un día el viento le voló el sombrero que cayó sobre las turbulentas aguas del entonces crecido río Tiribi, arrastrándolo en su corriente. Ella voló en su persecución. La cabeza de agua de la gran creciente la ahogó.

claims.statement: In Canadian folklore, the Turtle Lake Monster reportedly inhabits Turtle Lake in West Central Saskatchewan.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Kanada, Turtle Lake Monster adalah makhluk yang konon menghuni Turtle Lake di Saskatchewan barat-tengah.
claims.quote: In Canadian folklore, the Turtle Lake Monster is an entity purportedly inhabiting Turtle Lake, in West Central Saskatchewan, Canada.

claims.statement: It is usually described as 3 to 9 m long, with no dorsal fin and a head like a dog, seahorse or pig.
claims.statement_id: Monster ini biasanya digambarkan sepanjang 3 hingga 9 meter, tanpa sirip punggung, dengan kepala mirip anjing, kuda laut, atau babi.
claims.quote: The monster is usually described as a creature 3–9 m (9.8–29.5 ft) long, scaly or smooth, with no dorsal fin, and a head resembling either a dog, a seahorse, or a pig.

claims.statement: Reports go back to pre-settlement days, when the Cree told of people who entered its territory and vanished.
claims.statement_id: Laporannya sudah ada sebelum masa pemukiman, ketika orang Cree punya legenda tentang orang yang masuk wilayahnya dan hilang tanpa jejak.
claims.quote: Reports date back to pre-settlement days when the local Cree had a legend about people who ventured into the Turtle Lake Monster's territory and vanished without a trace.

claims.statement: Sightings may be of an unusually large lake sturgeon, or relict plesiosaurs.
claims.statement_id: Ada dugaan penampakannya adalah ikan sturgeon danau yang sangat besar atau sisa populasi plesiosaurus.
claims.quote: There is speculation that the monster sightings may be attributed to sightings of an unusually large lake sturgeon, or a relict population of prehistoric plesiosaurs.

claims.statement: Turtle Lake is about 100 km north of North Battleford.
claims.statement_id: Turtle Lake berjarak sekitar 100 km di utara North Battleford.
claims.quote: Turtle Lake is about 100 km north of North Battleford.

claims.statement: Some people who have seen it say it is about three to nine metres long, some say smooth-skinned and others scaly, and witnesses also say it has a horse-like or dog-like head.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian orang yang pernah melihatnya menyebut panjangnya sekitar tiga hingga sembilan meter; ada yang menyebut kulitnya halus, ada yang bersisik, dan saksi juga menyebut kepalanya mirip kuda atau anjing.
claims.quote: Some people who have seen the TLM say it’s about three to nine metres long. Some say it’s smooth-skinned. Others say it’s scaly. Witnesses also say it has a horse-like or dog-like head.

claims.statement: A man who wrote to the article's publisher recalled that as a child in 1985 he and his brother spotted the monster, which he described as a large fishlike creature perhaps seven to 10 feet long.
claims.statement_id: Seorang pria yang menulis kepada penerbit artikel mengenang bahwa pada 1985, saat masih anak-anak, ia dan saudaranya melihat monster itu, yang ia gambarkan sebagai makhluk besar mirip ikan, mungkin sepanjang tujuh hingga sepuluh kaki.
claims.quote: recalling how as a child in 1985, he and his brother spotted the TLM. ... it was a large fishlike creature, perhaps seven to 10 feet long.

claims.statement: Skeptics think it could be a moose out for a swim.
claims.statement_id: Kaum skeptis menduga makhluk itu mungkin seekor moose yang sedang berenang.
claims.quote: Skeptics think it could be a moose out for a swim.

claims.statement: Fisheries staff said they did depth soundings of Turtle Lake and never saw anything that suggested a monster lived there.
claims.statement_id: Staf perikanan mengatakan mereka melakukan pengukuran kedalaman Turtle Lake dan tidak pernah melihat apa pun yang menunjukkan adanya monster di sana.
claims.quote: The fisheries staff said they did depth soundings of Turtle Lake and never saw anything that suggested a monster lived there.

claims.statement: An 84-year-old First Nation woman interviewed for an article recalled that after she moved to Turtle Lake, people told her to stay away from the eastern shore, near the deepest points of the lake where the monster lived.
claims.statement_id: Seorang perempuan First Nation berusia 84 tahun yang diwawancarai untuk sebuah artikel mengenang bahwa setelah pindah ke Turtle Lake, orang-orang menyuruhnya menjauhi tepi timur, dekat titik terdalam danau tempat monster itu tinggal.
claims.quote: an 84-year-old First Nation woman interviewed for the article recalled ... Later when she moved to Turtle Lake, people told her to stay away from the Eastern shore, near the deepest points of the lake where the monster lived.

claims.statement: According to the article, the initial purpose of these lake monster stories, regardless of continental origin, is to teach children to respect the water as dangerous.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel itu, tujuan awal cerita-cerita monster danau semacam ini, apa pun asal benuanya, adalah mengajari anak-anak menghormati air sebagai sesuatu yang berbahaya.
claims.quote: The initial purpose of these stories, regardless of continental origin, is to teach children to respect the water as dangerous.

claims.statement: Ulmecatl is one of the six giant sons of Mixcoatl and Tlaltecuhtli who populated the Earth after the Great Flood in the Fifth Sun of Aztec mythology.
claims.statement_id: Ulmecatl adalah salah satu dari enam raksasa putra Mixcoatl dan Tlaltecuhtli yang menghuni Bumi setelah Air Bah pada masa Matahari Kelima dalam mitologi Aztek.
claims.quote: Ulmecatl (from Nahuatl, 'where the rubber is born') is one of the six giants sons of Mixcoatl and Tlaltecuhtli that populated the Earth after the Great Flood during the Fifth Sun in Aztec Mythology.

claims.statement: He was the third son, founder of Cuetlachoapan, where Puebla now stands, as well as Tontonihuacan and Huitzilapan.
claims.statement_id: Ia putra ketiga yang mendirikan Cuetlachoapan, tempat kota Puebla kini berada, serta Tontonihuacan dan Huitzilapan.
claims.quote: The third son who founded Cuetlachoapan, the place where Puebla is now, in addition to Tontonihuacan and Huitzilapan.

claims.statement: In this Nahoa cosmogony poem, the "ferocious serpent of white cloud" who lives in Citlálco is joined with her, six tlacámes (men) are engendered, and these brothers dwell on the earth and become the source of many races.
claims.statement_id: Dalam puisi kosmogoni Nahoa ini, "ular ganas dari awan putih" yang tinggal di Citlálco bersatu dengannya, enam tlacáme (laki-laki) lahir, dan saudara-saudara itu tinggal di bumi serta menjadi sumber banyak bangsa.
claims.quote: the «ferocious serpent Of white cloud» which lives in Citlálco, (24) With her is joined in sweet union, Of love, which six tlacámes engender; (25) These brothers dwell on the earth And become the source of many races:

claims.statement: A footnote in the same book says the Indians believed the earth was first inhabited by giants, and that the large fossilized bones found in excavations were their remains; they called them quinametzin.
claims.statement_id: Catatan kaki dalam buku yang sama menyebut bahwa orang Indian percaya bumi mula-mula dihuni raksasa, dan tulang besar yang ditemukan dalam keadaan fosil di galian dianggap sisa-sisa mereka; mereka menyebutnya quinametzin.
claims.quote: The Indians believed that the earth was first inhabited by giants, and the large pachyderm bones that were found in a fossilized state in excavations, were their remains. They called them quinametzin,

claims.statement: The poem names the six brothers in turn: Xélhua the firstborn (a giant), Tenoch, Ulmécatl, Xicaláncatl, Mixtécatl, and Otómitl, "the Xocóyotl".
claims.statement_id: Puisi itu menyebut keenam bersaudara berurutan: Xélhua si sulung (raksasa), Tenoch, Ulmécatl, Xicaláncatl, Mixtécatl, dan Otómitl, "Xocóyotl".
claims.quote: The firstborn, the giant Xélhua, ... Tenoch, the great ... The strong Cuetlaxcoápan founded Ulmécatl; ... Xicaláncatl; ... The valiant Mixtécatl guards himself ... Otómitl, the Xocóyotl, lives ever

claims.statement: A footnote says Cuetlaxcoapan was the place where the city of Puebla stands today, and that Ulmécatl founded other places besides it.
claims.statement_id: Catatan kaki menyatakan bahwa Cuetlaxcoapan adalah tempat kota Puebla kini berada, dan bahwa Ulmécatl mendirikan (tempat-tempat) lain di samping itu.
claims.quote: Cuetlaxcoapan was the place where today is the city of Puebla. (Ulmécatl) founded besides

claims.statement: In Lakota mythology, Unhcegila is a serpent-like creature blamed for many unexplained disappearances and deaths; her male counterpart is Unk Tehi.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Lakota, Unhcegila adalah makhluk mirip ular yang dianggap penyebab banyak kematian dan kehilangan misterius; pasangan jantannya bernama Unk Tehi.
claims.quote: is a serpentoid creature which was responsible for many unexplained disappearances and deaths. Her male counterpart is known as Unk Tehi.

claims.statement: Her form was later revealed as massive, with a long scaly body whose armor was almost impenetrable.
claims.statement_id: Belakangan wujudnya terungkap sangat besar, bertubuh panjang bersisik dengan pelindung alami yang hampir tak tertembus.
claims.quote: As time went on further, her form was exposed as being massive, with a long scaly body whose natural armor was almost impenetrable.

claims.statement: Whoever looks upon her goes blind or insane.
claims.statement_id: Siapa pun yang memandangnya akan buta atau gila.
claims.quote: Whoever looked upon her will become blind or go insane.

claims.statement: Her weakness is the seventh spot on her torso, over her heart; to kill her, one must shoot a medicine arrow there.
claims.statement_id: Kelemahannya adalah titik ketujuh di badannya, tempat jantungnya berada; untuk membunuhnya, panah obat harus ditembakkan ke titik itu.
claims.quote: Her weakness is the seventh spot on her torso, behind which lies her heart. To kill her, one has to shoot a medicine arrow at this flaw in her natural armor.

claims.statement: She was first described as having no real shape or form, with eyes of fire and a fanged mouth shrouded in a smoky or cloudy mass.
claims.statement_id: Pada mulanya ia digambarkan tanpa bentuk yang nyata, bermata api, dengan mulut bertaring yang diselubungi massa seperti asap atau awan.
claims.quote: She was described at first as having no real shape or form; she had eyes of fire, and a fanged mouth that was shrouded in a smoky or cloudy mass.

claims.statement: Her eyes burned with wrathful hunger, her claws were like iron and her voice raged like thunder rolling in the clouds.
claims.statement_id: Matanya menyala dengan kelaparan murka, cakarnya seperti besi, dan suaranya mengamuk seperti guntur bergulung di awan.
claims.quote: Her eyes burned with wrathful hunger, her claws were like iron, and her voice raged like thunder rolling in the clouds.

claims.statement: According to the accounts, the creature and her companion finally made their way to the Black Hills (Pahá Sápa) and sought a new home in the mountains.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kisah-kisah itu, makhluk ini dan pasangannya akhirnya sampai ke Black Hills (Pahá Sápa) dan mencari rumah baru di pegunungan.
claims.quote: Until they made their way to the Black Hills (Pahá Sápa) and sought a new home in the mountains.

claims.statement: In one myth Unk Cekula fights and kills a giant bear, whose fallen body produced Bear Butte in the Black Hills.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu mitos, Unk Cekula bertarung dengan beruang raksasa dan membunuhnya; tubuh beruang yang rubuh itu membentuk Bear Butte di Black Hills.
claims.quote: In one myth, Unk Cekula fights with and kills a giant bear, whose fallen body produced the Bear Butte in the Black Hills.

claims.statement: Alternatively, two twin brothers, one of them blind, killed Unk Cekula with arrows given to them by a medicine woman.
claims.statement_id: Menurut versi lain, dua saudara kembar, salah satunya buta, membunuh Unk Cekula dengan panah pemberian seorang tabib perempuan.
claims.quote: Alternatively, two twin brothers, one of whom was blind, killed Unk Cekula using arrows given to them by a medicine woman.

claims.statement: In another myth Unk Cekula emerged from the primordial waters and flooded the land; the devastation angered Wakinyan, who flapped his wings to create a great storm to dry the land and shoot lightning, killing Unk Cekula.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitos lain, Unk Cekula muncul dari perairan purba dan membanjiri daratan; kehancuran itu membuat Wakinyan murka, yang mengepakkan sayapnya menciptakan badai besar untuk mengeringkan tanah dan menembakkan petir sehingga membunuh Unk Cekula.
claims.quote: In another myth, Unk Cekula emerged from the primordial waters to flood the land. The resulting devastation angered Wakinyan, who flapped his wings to create a great storm to dry up the land and shoot lightning, killing Unk Cekula.

claims.statement: As she finally died the Sun scorched her flesh and dried up the land, resulting in the arid rock formations and skeletons found in the Badlands.
claims.statement_id: Ketika ia akhirnya mati, Matahari menghanguskan dagingnya dan mengeringkan tanah, menghasilkan formasi batu gersang dan kerangka yang ditemukan di Badlands.
claims.quote: As she finally died, the Sun scorched her flesh and dried up the land, resulting in the arid rock formations and skeletons found in the Badlands

claims.statement: It was learned that the creature had offspring, and the tribes had to kill them when they began feeding on people.
claims.statement_id: Diketahui makhluk itu memiliki keturunan, dan suku-suku harus membunuh mereka ketika mulai memangsa manusia.
claims.quote: It was learned that the creature had offspring, and the tribes had to kill them when they began feeding on people.

claims.statement: A fictionalized version of the myth appeared in a Marvel Comics Presents story arc starring Wolverine.
claims.statement_id: Versi fiksi mitos ini muncul dalam alur cerita Marvel Comics Presents dengan Wolverine sebagai bintang.
claims.quote: A fictionalized version of the myth appeared in a Marvel Comics Presents story arc starring Wolverine.

claims.statement: She appears in a story told in the 2003 film Dreamkeeper, in which Eagle Boy slays her with weapons given to him by an old woman.
claims.statement_id: Ia muncul dalam kisah yang dituturkan dalam film Dreamkeeper (2003), tempat Eagle Boy membunuhnya dengan senjata pemberian seorang perempuan tua.
claims.quote: She appears in a story told in the 2003 film Dreamkeeper, in which Eagle Boy is the one who slays her with weapons given to him by an old woman.

claims.statement: According to Native Languages of the Americas, Unktehila is the horned water serpent of Lakota and Dakota mythology, the diametrical opponent of the Thunderbird Wakinyan, with many legends of epic fights between the two.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Native Languages of the Americas, Unktehila adalah ular air bertanduk dalam mitologi Lakota dan Dakota, lawan utama Burung Guntur Wakinyan, dan ada banyak legenda tentang pertarungan dahsyat keduanya.
claims.quote: Unktehila is the horned water serpent of Lakota and Dakota mythology. It is the diametrical opponent of the Thunderbird Wakinyan, and there are many legends about epic fights between the two.

claims.statement: The page lists the name Unktehila, tribal affiliation Dakota and Lakota, with alternate spellings Uncegila, Unhcegila and Unktehi.
claims.statement_id: Halaman itu mencantumkan nama Unktehila, berafiliasi suku Dakota dan Lakota, dengan ejaan lain Uncegila, Unhcegila, dan Unktehi.
claims.quote: Name: Unktehila Tribal affiliation: Dakota, Lakota Alternate spellings: Uncegila, Unhcegila, Unktehi

claims.statement: Dorsey writes that the Unkteḣi (subaquatic and subterranean powers) are many gods, the most powerful of all; in outward form they are said to resemble the ox but of immense proportions, and they can extend their horns and tails to reach the skies.
claims.statement_id: Dorsey menulis bahwa para Unkteḣi (kekuatan bawah air dan bawah tanah) adalah banyak dewa, yang paling berkuasa dari semuanya; rupa luarnya disebut seperti sapi jantan berukuran sangat besar, dan mereka dapat memanjangkan tanduk dan ekornya hingga mencapai langit.
claims.quote: THE UNKTEḢI, OR SUBAQUATIC AND SUBTERRANEAN POWERS. ... The gods of this name, for there are many, are the most powerful of all. In their external form they are said to resemble the ox, only they are of immense proportions. They can extend their horns and tails so as to reach the skies.

claims.statement: According to Dorsey, in the Dakota cosmogony this was done by the Unkteḣi, called in the Teton dialect Ŭñktcexila or Uŋkćeġila.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dorsey, dalam kosmogoni Dakota hal itu dilakukan oleh Unkteḣi, yang dalam dialek Teton disebut Ŭñktcexila atau Uŋkćeġila.
claims.quote: According to the Dakota cosmogony, this was done by the Unkteḣi, called in the Teton dialect Ŭñktcexila or Uŋkćeġila.

claims.statement: According to Dorsey, the Unkteḣi are thought to feed on the spirits of human beings, as referred to in the mystic songs.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dorsey, Unkteḣi dianggap memakan roh manusia, dan hal itu disinggung dalam lagu-lagu mistik.
claims.quote: The Unkteḣi are thought to feed on the spirits of human beings, and references to this occur in the mystic songs.

claims.statement: According to Dorsey, the subordinates of the Unkteḣi are serpents, lizards, frogs, ghosts, owls and eagles, and the Unkteḣi made the earth and men.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dorsey, bawahan Unkteḣi adalah ular, kadal, katak, hantu, burung hantu, dan elang, dan Unkteḣi menciptakan bumi dan manusia.
claims.quote: The subordinates of the Unkteḣi are serpents, lizards, frogs, ghosts, owls, and eagles. The Unkteḣi made the earth and men

claims.statement: According to Gatschet, Unktéhi or Unktéxi was their "Neptune" or divine ruler of the waters, and the name also designated a fabled monster of the deep and the whale of the salt water.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Gatschet, Unktéhi atau Unktéxi adalah "Neptunus" atau penguasa ilahi perairan bagi mereka, dan namanya juga menyebut monster laut dalam yang diceritakan serta paus air asin.
claims.quote: It will, however, suffice to mention Unktéhi, or Unktéxi, their Neptune or divine ruler of the waters, whose name also designated a fabled monster of the deep and the whale of the salt-water.

claims.statement: Yahui is a supernatural figure of mixed animal and human forms in Mixtec culture and belief.
claims.statement_id: Yahui adalah sosok gaib dengan berbagai campuran wujud hewan dan manusia dalam budaya dan kepercayaan Mixtec.
claims.quote: Yahui is a supernatural figure that takes on various mixtures of animal and human forms within the culture and belief systems of the Mixtec

claims.statement: It is an important recurring motif of Mixtec iconography, especially in the pre-Columbian era.
claims.statement_id: Yahui adalah motif penting dan berulang dalam ikonografi Mixtec, terutama pada masa pra-Kolumbus.
claims.quote: It is an important and recurring motif in Mixtec iconography, thought and culture, especially during the pre-Columbian era.

claims.statement: In Postclassic Mixtec codices the yahui wears a serpent tail and headdress and a turtle carapace.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kodeks Mixtec masa Pascaklasik, yahui tampil berekor dan berhiasan kepala ular serta bercangkang kura-kura.
claims.quote: the yahui appears in Postclassic Mixtec codices as an entity wearing a serpent or reptilian tail and headdress (similar to the xiuhcoatl motif) and the carapace of a turtle.

claims.statement: The yahui has two main forms: the nahual (man-animal composite) and the animal figure.
claims.statement_id: Yahui muncul dalam dua wujud utama: nahual (campuran manusia-hewan) dan wujud hewan.
claims.quote: The yahui appears in two main forms: the nahual, or man-animal composite figure, and the animal figure.

claims.statement: At times the nahual figures hold sacrificial knives and perform rites.
claims.statement_id: Kadang sosok nahual memegang pisau kurban dan melakukan ritual persembahan.
claims.quote: At times, the nahual figures holds sacrificial knives and perform sacrificial rites or other ceremonial activities.

claims.statement: In animal form the yahui combines a reptilian head with a tortoise-shell body, reptilian arms and legs, claws and the flint-fire motif on the tips of the tail and nose; the animal yahui appears in cosmogony scenes illustrating the origins of ritual and cultural phenomena.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujud hewan, yahui menggabungkan kepala reptil dengan tubuh bercangkang kura-kura, lengan dan kaki reptil, cakar, dan motif api-batu api pada ujung ekor dan hidung; yahui hewan tampil dalam adegan kosmogoni yang menggambarkan asal-usul ritual dan gejala budaya.
claims.quote: In the animal form, a reptilian head is combined with a tortoise shell body, reptilian arms and legs, claws and the flint-fire motif on the tips of the tail and nose. The animal yahui appears in cosmogony scenes illustrating the origins of ritual and cultural phenomena.

claims.statement: Depictions of yahui figures appear in several Mixtec codices, including the Codex Zouche-Nuttall, Codex Vindobonensis Mexicanus I, Codex Selden, Codex Bodley, Codex Egerton and Codex Becker I/II.
claims.statement_id: Gambar sosok yahui muncul dalam beberapa kodeks Mixtec, termasuk Codex Zouche-Nuttall, Codex Vindobonensis Mexicanus I, Codex Selden, Codex Bodley, Codex Egerton, dan Codex Becker I/II.
claims.quote: Depictions of yahui-figures appear in several Mixtec codices, including the Codex Zouche-Nuttall, Codex Vindobonensis Mexicanus I, Codex Selden, Codex Bodley, Codex Egerton, and Codex Becker I/II.

claims.statement: In nahual form the yahui's animal imagery is combined with a male human head; in some depictions the nahual has reptilian claws, in others human hands.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujud nahual, citra hewan yahui dipadukan dengan kepala manusia laki-laki; pada sebagian gambar nahual bercakar reptil, pada gambar lain bertangan manusia.
claims.quote: In the nahual form, the yahui animal imagery is combined with a male, human head. In some depictions, the nahual possesses reptilian claws, while other depictions portray the figure with human hands.

claims.statement: The yahui appears in a few other pre-Columbian works of art; one can be viewed by the public in one of the Zapotec tombs in Zaachila.
claims.statement_id: Yahui juga muncul dalam beberapa karya seni pra-Kolumbus lain; salah satunya dapat dilihat publik di salah satu makam Zapotek di Zaachila.
claims.quote: The yahui appears in a few other works of art from the pre-Columbian era. One of these depictions is viewable by the public in one of the Zapotec tombs in Zaachila.

claims.statement: As a real historical figure, the yahui probably performed cosmological rites in caves and on hilltops.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai tokoh sejarah nyata, yahui kemungkinan besar melakukan ritus kosmologis di gua dan di puncak bukit.
claims.quote: As a real, historical figure, the yahui probably performed cosmological rites in caves and on hilltops.

claims.statement: Mary Elizabeth Smith identified the yahui as the "xiuhcoatl-turtle-sacrificer".
claims.statement_id: Mary Elizabeth Smith mengidentifikasi yahui sebagai "xiuhcoatl-kura-kura-pelaku kurban".
claims.quote: Mary Elizabeth Smith identified the yahui as the "xiuhcoatl-turtle-sacrificer"

claims.statement: According to Pohl's description of page 11 of the Codex Selden, the River of the Twisted Serpent is surmounted by a jaguar, a coyote, a fire serpent priest called a yahui, and an eagle.
claims.statement_id: Menurut uraian Pohl atas halaman 11 Codex Selden, Sungai Ular Berpilin dimahkotai seekor jaguar, seekor coyote, seorang imam ular api yang disebut yahui, dan seekor elang.
claims.quote: Page 11, Band IV: River of the Twisted Serpent is surmounted by a jaguar, a coyote, a fire serpent priest called a yahui, and an eagle (61).

claims.statement: According to Pohl's description of page 12 of the Codex Selden, human hearts, perhaps those of Thirteen Deer and another captured man, are delivered to the Sun God by a yahui priest and an eagle before the Temple of Jaltepec.
claims.statement_id: Menurut uraian Pohl atas halaman 12 Codex Selden, jantung manusia, mungkin milik Thirteen Deer dan seorang tawanan lain, dipersembahkan kepada Dewa Matahari oleh seorang imam yahui dan seekor elang di depan Kuil Jaltepec.
claims.quote: Page 12, Band II: Human hearts, perhaps those of Thirteen Deer and the other man who was captured on Page 12, Band I, are delivered to the Sun God by a yahui priest and an eagle before the Temple of Jaltepec.

claims.statement: Zapam Zucum is a dark-skinned, white-handed goddess of the Aymara and Diaguita of northern Argentina, Chile and Bolivia.
claims.statement_id: Zapam Zucum adalah dewi berkulit gelap dan bertangan putih di kalangan orang Aymara dan Diaguita di utara Argentina, Chile, dan Bolivia.
claims.quote: Zapam Zucum or Zapam-zucún is a voluptuous, dark-skinned, and white-handed goddess among the Aymara and Diaguita populations of northerly parts of Argentina and Chile as well as  Bolivia.

claims.statement: She is considered the protectress of the algarrobo tree.
claims.statement_id: Ia dianggap pelindung pohon algarrobo.
claims.quote: She is considered the protectoress of the algarrobo tree

claims.statement: When the goddess dwells in the tree, the sound "Zapam... Zucum" is heard and the children stave off hunger.
claims.statement_id: Jika sang dewi menghuni pohon itu, bunyi "Zapam... Zucum" terdengar dan anak-anak tidak merasa lapar.
claims.quote: If the goddess inhabits the tree, the sound of "Zapam... Zucum" can be heard, and the children stave their hunger for some reason.

claims.statement: She guards the sacred algarrobo; hearing an axe chopping it, she abducts the logger.
claims.statement_id: Ia penjaga pohon algarrobo yang suci; jika mendengar bunyi kapak menebang pohon, ia menculik penebangnya entah ke mana.
claims.quote: The goddess is the guardian of the sacred algarrobo tree, and when she hears the "chac.. chac" noise of someone chopping at the tree with an ax, she will relentlessly abduct the logger to who knows where.

claims.statement: She protects baby and young animals from predators and hunters.
claims.statement_id: Sang dewi melindungi anak-anak hewan dari pemangsa dan pemburu.
claims.quote: The goddess protects baby and juvenile animals from predatory beasts and hunters

claims.statement: In a variant telling, the logger's children are spirited away.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi lain, anak-anak si penebang yang diculik secara gaib.
claims.quote: In a variant telling, the logger's children get spirited away.

claims.statement: Sometimes she wreaks vengeance on evil and abusive men by seducing and suffocating them.
claims.statement_id: Kadang ia membalas dendam kepada lelaki jahat dan kasar dengan merayu dan mencekik mereka.
claims.quote: Sometimes she will wreak vengeance upon evil and abusive men by seducing and suffocating them.

claims.statement: In some regions it is told that she appears in gigantic form to hunt down lazy men who loafed off work in the fields, capture them with her enormous breasts and carry them off.
claims.statement_id: Di beberapa daerah diceritakan ia tampil dalam wujud raksasa untuk memburu lelaki malas yang menghindar dari kerja di ladang, menangkap mereka dengan payudaranya yang sangat besar, dan membawa mereka pergi.
claims.quote: In some regions, it is told how she will appear in gigantic form to hunt down lazy men who have loafed off of working in the fields, capture the men with her enormous breasts, and carry them off somewhere.

claims.statement: She has long black hair and black eyes, but supple white hands of a skin tone different from her dark complexion; with those hands she crafts a cradle out of leaves and tucks the toddlers in to nap.
claims.statement_id: Ia berambut dan bermata hitam, tetapi bertangan putih lembut yang warnanya berbeda dari kulitnya yang gelap; dengan tangan itu ia membuat buaian dari daun dan menidurkan anak-anak balita.
claims.quote: She has long black hair and black eyes, but supple white hand of a skin-tone different from her general dark complexion. With those hands she will craft a cradle out of leaves and tuck in the toddlers to nap.

claims.statement: Among the Aymara, who live in La Rioja Province in the Argentine Northwest, Bolivia and northern Chile, the algarrobo tree ("carob") is held sacred.
claims.statement_id: Di kalangan orang Aymara, yang tinggal di Provinsi La Rioja di barat laut Argentina, Bolivia, dan Chile utara, pohon algarrobo ("carob") dianggap suci.
claims.quote: Among the Aymara, whose population dwell in La Rioja Province in the Argentine Northwest, Bolivia, and northern Chile, the algarrobo tree ("carob") is held sacred.

claims.statement: Her breasts are enormous and make the "Zapam... Zucum" sound when she moves, hence her name.
claims.statement_id: Payudaranya sangat besar dan menimbulkan bunyi "Zapam... Zucum" ketika ia bergerak, itulah asal namanya.
claims.quote: Her breasts are enormous, and makes the aforesaid "Zapam... Zucum" sound when she maneuvers, hence her name.

claims.statement: According to the text, the ancients who saw her painted her as a still-young woman in the fullness of vigor, her face tanned by the sun, with black eyes and hair and a pair of enormous brown-and-pink breasts as her particular sign.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks itu, orang-orang zaman dahulu yang pernah melihatnya melukiskan seorang perempuan yang masih muda, penuh tenaga hidup, berwajah terbakar matahari, bermata dan berambut hitam, dengan sepasang payudara besar yang kecokelatan dan kemerahan.
claims.quote: Quienes la han visto, entre los antiguos, la pintan una mujer joven aún, arrebolada por los colores de una vida en la plenitud de su vigor, tostado de sol el rostro; ojos y cabellos negros y como signo particular, un par de enormes senos morenos y rosados a la vez

claims.statement: According to the text, the hungry children who wake up suckle at the goddess's bountiful breasts instead of their mothers'.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks itu, anak-anak kecil yang lapar dan terbangun menyusu pada dada sang dewi yang murah hati sebagai ganti dada ibu mereka.
claims.quote: Pero los pequeños tienen hambre y se despiertan, y en vez del seno materno, se amamantan en los pechos próvidos de la diosa

claims.statement: According to the text, mothers who leave their children under Zapam-Zucum's shelter know a solicitous providence will watch over them.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks itu, para ibu yang meninggalkan anak mereka di bawah naungan Zapam-Zucum tahu bahwa penyelenggaraan yang penuh perhatian akan menjaga mereka.
claims.quote: Las madres, al dejarlos bajo el amparo de la Zapam-Zucum, saben que una providencia solícita velará sobre ellos.

claims.statement: According to the text, near the camp where only the sleeping little ones were left, one hears the resounding, characteristic sound announcing the approach of the favorable deity.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks itu, dekat perkemahan tempat hanya anak-anak yang tidur ditinggalkan, terdengar bunyi tegas dan khas yang menandakan dekatnya dewa yang berbaik hati.
claims.quote: se siente, próximo al campamento, donde sólo quedaron los pequeños dormidos, el sonido rotundo y característico que anuncia la proximidad del numen propicio

claims.statement: According to the text, Zapam-Zucum is the mother and providence of children and of the algarrobo trees; she tends and defends the trees so their fruits may be offered to poor people, and delights in the simple festivals held under the trees.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks itu, Zapam-Zucum adalah ibu dan penyelenggara anak-anak dan pohon algarrobo; ia merawat dan membela pohon itu agar buahnya dapat diberikan kepada orang miskin, dan senang dengan pesta sederhana yang diadakan di bawah pohon.
claims.quote: La Zapam-Zucum es la madre y providencia de los niños y de los algarrobos. Cuida a éstos y los defiende, para ofrecer sus frutos a las pobres gentes y se complace con las fiestas sencillas que se celebran debajo de los árboles

claims.statement: According to the text, woe to the reckless person who needlessly destroys her heritage and temple, hacks the algarrobo trees, strips their branches or knocks down green fruit or flower with ill intent: Zapam-Zucum takes horrible revenge, stealing the wrongdoer's children and never returning them.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks itu, celakalah orang nekat yang merusak tanpa alasan warisan dan kuilnya, menebang pohon algarrobo, menggugurkan daunnya, atau menjatuhkan buah dan bunganya dengan niat jahat: Zapam-Zucum membalas dengan mengerikan, mencuri anak si jahat dan tidak mengembalikannya.
claims.quote: ¡Y guay del osado que destroce inmotivadamente su heredad y templo, que hache los algarrobos, que deshoje sus ramas o voltee, con espíritu de hacer mal, sus frutos verdes aún o la pishuca de la flor! La Zapam-Zucum se venga en forma horrible, roba los hijos del malvado y no los devuelve más.

claims.statement: According to this dictionary of myths, the name comes from a sound.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus mitos ini, nama itu berasal dari sebuah bunyi.
claims.quote: Este nombre proviene de un sonido

claims.statement: According to this dictionary of myths, she punishes those who cut green algarroba and those who chop the algarrobo trees, and the text mentions a child who is not to be returned.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus mitos ini, ia menghukum orang yang memotong algarroba hijau dan yang menebang pohon algarrobo, dan teks menyebut seorang anak yang tidak akan dikembalikan.
claims.quote: Castiga a los que cortan algarroba verde y a los que hachan los algarrobos con ... un hijo para no devolverlo

claims.statement: According to this dictionary of myths, she is the great friend of those left behind while the mothers harvest into sacks; when they wake she nurses them at her breasts and they go back to sleep.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus mitos ini, ia sahabat besar mereka yang ditinggalkan selagi para ibu memanen dengan karung; ketika mereka terbangun ia menyusui mereka dan mereka tidur kembali.
claims.quote: la gran amiga de los ... abandonados mientras las madres cocechan en costales; cuando despiertan los amamanta con sus pechos y vuelven a dormir
